431. Prefix-Free String Checker

70

Problem Statement:
Carlos goes digging for gold and uncovers a machine that can accept strings as input. The machine requires N strings to be inserted. Only one condition exists: no string must be a prefix of a string that was input before it.If the condition is not followed the machine will explode If the above condition is followed the machine dispenses 1000 gold coins and that would make carlos very happy. But since Carlos is tired from digging he takes rest and asks his assistant to enter the N strings into the machine. The assistant however is not very clever and tends to make mistakes.So he has decided to take your help He will give you N strings and ask you if the machine will dispense the gold coins or explode Give him the required answer

Input Description:
The first line contains a single integer N denoting the number of strings to be inserted
The next N lines contain a string each denoting the string his assistant inputs , in that specific order
output_spec:
Output a single line If the machine will explode output the first string that caused it to explode after printing the text “Bad input” without quotes
Or if it won’t explode output “1000 Gold coins dispensed”
